exceptional_mode.sequence: abort -> halt -> DRAIN 32 quiet -> HOST link reset (both PHYs, forwarded link-reset bump) -> retrain -> HOST clear -> forwarded epoch strobe (3-cycle bump) -> both ends epoch+1 on the same cycle -> HOST replays the layer/token
exceptional_mode.note: PHY train time is the behavioural model's UP=16; a real UCIe retrain is longer; exceptional mode only
